title: Guantarious's Tweaks
description: A small modpack containing completely client-sided mods targeting optimization and QoL tweaks.
body:
A small modpack containing completely client-sided mods targeting optimization and QoL tweaks.

# Optimization
### Simply Optimized
- Modpack solely to boost FPS and memory usage

# QoL Tweaks
### Mini HUD
- Allows you a small, customizable, toggleable debug (F3) menu that is much less invasive than the normal debug menu. I use it to always show my coordinates but not the rest of the debug menu.
### Litematica
- Technical mod that allows you to use a stick to quickly create schematics of builds to later place as a shadow of blocks in any location. The schematic is saved as a file on your computer so you can use across worlds and download/upload schematics which is helpful for larger builds. A schematic will also tell you the number of materials needed to complete the schematic.
### Distant Horizons
- Render chunks that are past the set render distance if a chunk in the set mod distance has been loaded previously, very useful for Aternos servers.
### BetterF3
- Replaces the debug menu with a customizable and more readable menu. The ability to remove modules you don't want to see and color coding modules is super nice.
### Mod Menu
- Adds a menu to view and edit mod options in the Minecraft's pause menu.

# Other
### **If Low Performance Then Lower Distant Horizons Mod Distance In Mod Menu**
The base mod distance is set to be pretty high on default, I run on 32 chunks mod distance and cap my FPS at 120 and with the mod distance at 32 I never drop below 120 FPS
